SwimWeek shows your weekly swimming distance from Health Connect. Data stays on this phone. We do not upload workouts to a server, and this app does not use the internet.

We request read access to:
• Exercise sessions (to find pool and open-water swims)
• Distance (to total meters for those sessions)
• Background read (optional, for the home-screen widget)

We never write workouts and do not request health history beyond the platform default window.
No INTERNET permission. Derived weekly totals are stored only on device and excluded from backup.
